name: milton-auth-mail-problems
description: milton-auth-mail sends that ended failed (a non-429 4xx from Resend, a missed delivery deadline or an undecryptable message) or throttled (a Resend 429): one JSON line each, {"message":"auth_mail_send","outcome":"failed"|"throttled"} (apps/auth/src/mail-log.ts). Read by milton-auth-mail.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="milton-auth-mail" AND jsonPayload.message="auth_mail_send" AND jsonPayload.outcome=("failed" OR "throttled")
